Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor c1 is
 select distinct unit_id, coll_date
 from holding_tests
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id and
 test_chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 holding_status is null;
 temp_coll_date date;
begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 temp_coll_date:=c1_rec.coll_date;
 
 If c1_rec.coll_date is null then 
 
 begin
 select coll_date into temp_coll_date from units where unit_id=c1_rec.unit_id and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and 
 rownum=1;
 exception 
 when others then 
 temp_coll_date:=null;
 end;
 
 End If;
 
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date := temp_coll_date;
 
 IF length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id) = 13 THEN 
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := chk_digit_query( :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id, 
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date, 
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 END IF;
 down;
 end loop;
 if :system.trigger_record = '1' and
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('tb_id');
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 clear_record;
 :s_count_units := :system.trigger_record;
 :GLOBAL.field_left := 'void_reason_code';
 go_record('1');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: REPORT_GENERATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE (pl_parm_id in varchar2) IS
parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 --val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;
 v_rep VARCHAR2(100);
 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);
 
--for Apps server 
report_id Report_Object;
ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);

 -- Multiple reports server changes;
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(70);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 
 ------------
--val:='rep_chdevsrv10_oracleas1'; 
--filename:=:rpt_parm.report_name||'_'||'_'||user;
 
filename:='tervoid'||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower('tervoid')); 


SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,pl_parm_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,'1');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:global.chapter_id);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'N');
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.auto_print_flag);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RPT_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper('tervoid'));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(:banner.user_id)); -- New parameter to allow the reports to run at a specified date and time


 
ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);


vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
--message('Status='||vc_rep_status);

message('TERVOID Report Submitted ... ');


update rpt_parm 
 set rep_job_id = vjob_id,
 rep_server = l_svr_name
 where upper(report_name)=upper('tervoid') 
 and user_name = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and parm_id=pl_parm_id;
 
:system.message_level:=15;
commit; 
:system.message_level:=0;
 Exception 
 when others then 

message(sqlerrm);pause;
 
END;

 --message(:global.void_cancel_id);pause;

Trigger.Name: PERFORM_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 clear_flag varchar2(1) := 'N';
 
 cursor holding_tests_cur is select * from holding_tests where tb_id=:ctrl_blk_1.tb_id and test_id= :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 temp_coll_date date;
begin
 begin
 update holding_tests
 set holding_status='C'
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in updating the holding tests.');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 FOR Z in holding_tests_cur
 loop
 
 Begin
 
 temp_coll_date:=Z.coll_date;
 
 If Z.coll_date is null then
 
 begin
 select coll_date into temp_coll_date from units where unit_id=Z.unit_id and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and 
 rownum=1;
 exception 
 when others then 
 temp_coll_date:=null;
 end;
 
 End If;
 
 
 
 
 insert into test_voids
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_seq_no, test_id,
 test_state, test_mode, result_status_1, result_status_2,
 tb_id, test_chapter_id, tb_seq_no, well_number, absorbance,
 ratio, result_dats, result_user_id, testing_lab_code,
 insert_dats, insert_user_id, void_type, void_reason_code,
 void_dats, void_user_id,void_cancel_id)
 values
 (Z.unit_id, temp_coll_date, nvl(Z.chapter_id,:global.chapter_id),
 1, Z.test_id, Z.test_state,
 Z.test_mode, Z.result_status_1,
 Z.result_status_2, Z.tb_id,
 Z.test_chapter_id, Z.tb_seq_no,
 Z.well_number, Z.absorbance, Z.ratio,
 Z.result_dats, Z.result_user_id,
 Z.testing_lab_code, sysdate,
 Z.insert_user_id, 'D', 'CATB',
 sysdate, :banner.user_id, null);
 Exception
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in inserting in test voids');
 handle_error;
 End;
 
 END LOOP;
 
 begin
 delete from test_batch_det 
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id 
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id 
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in deleting from test_bat_det.');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 declare
 temp_x varchar2(1); 
 begin
 select 'x' into temp_x from dual
 where exists 
 (select 'x' from test_batch_det 
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id 
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.test_id');
 clear_item;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 delete from test_batch_hdr
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 clear_flag := 'Y';
 check_package_failure; 
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in deleting from test_batch_hdr');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if not form_success
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 set_report_parms('TERVOID',:banner.user_id||'_tervoid_'||to_char(sysdate,'mmddyyhh24miss') );
 IF clear_flag = 'Y' THEN
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

 exception

 exception
